register.name: Governance to Enable Service Delivery Project (GESD 2.0)
register.note: Performance grants for 28 district and 4 municipal councils
register.text: Pays performance-based grants to local authorities that meet set standards, for classrooms, health facilities, water points and community works, and trains council staff in procurement and financial management. Councils deliver most of the services behind the seven standards.

register.name: Mpatamanga Hydropower Storage Project
register.detail: Approved 15 May 2025 · IDA grant · 358.5 MW on the Shire River · Total cost expected above $1.5 billion
register.note: 1,544 GWh of clean power a year, subject to private financing
register.text: A public-private partnership co-developed by the Government of Malawi and IFC, with EDF and SN Malawi (British International Investment, Norfund and TotalEnergies) as strategic sponsors. Its main and regulating dams would generate and store power for peak demand, in a nation where 15.6% of citizens have electricity.

register.name: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation (ASCENT Malawi)
register.detail: IDA grant SDR 187.1 million · Financing agreement signed 24 January 2025 · Multiphase programme
register.note: About $245.8 million; power for more than 4 million people
register.text: Electricity for more than 4 million people and 1,280 schools and health facilities, and clean cooking for 650,000 Malawians, with ESMAP co-financing the clean cooking component. Clean cooking is the standard that holds Malawi’s Coverage at 2; at least $34 million of private finance is expected for off-grid power.

register.name: First Growth and Resilience Development Policy Operation with a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option
register.note: Funds that can be drawn when a disaster strikes
register.text: Budget support for reforms, with a contingent line that pays out after a declared disaster.

register.name: Emergency Project to Protect Essential Health Services
Social Support for Resilient Livelihoods Project
register.text: Cash transfers and livelihood support for poor households.

register.name: Malawi Electricity Access Project
register.note: Nearly two million people gained electricity
register.text: Connected more than 190,000 households to the grid and installed nearly 257,000 solar home systems: nearly two million people gained electricity, against a target of 1.6 million (World Bank, May 2026). Energy is the standard that sets Malawi’s Coverage.

register.name: Shire Valley Transformation Program, Phase 1
register.text: Brings irrigation and land tenure to the Shire Valley, raising farm incomes.

register.name: Enhancing Climate-Adapted Agricultural Productivity through Improved Water Management (CAWMA)
register.detail: Announced 23 June 2026 · ADF Climate Action Window grant · Total project $14.41 million · June 2026 to September 2031
register.note: Three irrigation schemes rebuilt after Cyclone Freddy
register.text: Rebuilds and climate-proofs three irrigation schemes covering 180 hectares in Phalombe and Thyolo, the districts hit hardest by Cyclone Freddy in 2023, trains about 28,000 farmers and restores 650 hectares of catchment. At least 40% of direct beneficiaries are to be women.

register.name: IFC loan to Illovo Sugar Malawi
register.detail: Announced 7 November 2025 · Kwacha-linked loan · IDA Private Sector Window Local Currency Facility
register.note: Irrigation at the Nchalo Sugar Estate
register.text: Upgrades bulk irrigation at Nchalo and links the estate to the main canal of the Shire Valley Transformation Program, saving about 34 million cubic metres of water a year. Illovo employs more than 10,000 people directly and about 5,000 more through its supply chain.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Lake
items.label: Mbuna species, all but five endemic
items.text: A World Heritage site since 1984, and a fishery and a coast for millions.

items.name: The Shire River
items.label: Renewable share of electricity output, 2021
items.text: Clean power, reaching 15.6% of citizens. The gap is the grid, not the source.
items.alt: The Shire River and its hydropower

items.name: The Land
items.label: Of land in agriculture, 2024
items.text: Maize, tobacco and tea, while a quarter of people are undernourished.
items.alt: Maize and tobacco fields in Malawi

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of land under forest, 2024
items.text: Woodland that protects the watersheds feeding the Shire.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: More than four in five live in the countryside.

items.name: Illovo Sugar Malawi
items.text: A sugar producer whose estates include Nchalo in the Shire Valley, employing more than 10,000 people directly and about 5,000 more through its supply chain. IFC lent it US$36 million in 2025 to upgrade irrigation.

items.name: Select Africa
items.text: A microfinance institution lending to civil servants and other low-income earners in Malawi, Lesotho and Eswatini, for small businesses, farming, school costs and homes. Swedfund lent it up to US$15 million in September 2025.
